subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as an explicit `sessions_send` mode, as a separate one-way primitive, or declined in favor of the existing conversation lifecycle plus narrower duplicate-message fixes?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the fix changes model-facing session semantics and compatibility for existing A2A workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clear one-way mode that preserves current conversation behavior by default and adds focused docs/tests for both modes.

options.title: Create separate delivery primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so one-way handoff cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`, at the cost of another model-facing tool.

options.title: Keep current lifecycle only
options.body: Treat reverse-call, announce, and presentation issues as narrower bugs and decline a new one-way core API until a larger A2A design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clear one-way mode that preserves current conversation behavior by default and adds focused docs/tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to this handle as the strongest available owner for session docs, inter-session provenance, and A2A lifecycle design.
